profile.name: Vivian Adjeikaa Doe
profile.tagline: Rhetoric and culture scholar, theatre artist and writing teacher, studying African digital activism and mediated communication.
profile.status: Open to research and teaching collaboration
profile.bio:
I am a Ph.D. student in Rhetoric, Theory and Culture at North Dakota State University, where I also teach first-year college composition as a Graduate Teaching Assistant.

I trained in theatre first. I hold a Bachelor of Arts in Theatre Arts from the University of Education, Winneba, and a Master of Fine Arts in Drama and Film Studies from The Central Academy of Drama in Beijing, where I also earned a certificate in Chinese language studies. I have taught drama, communication skills and African studies in Ghana and China, and directed and coordinated student productions.

My current research looks at African digital activism and mediated communication. I am a member of the Coalition of Feminist Scholars in the History of Rhetoric and Composition.
profile.interests: Rhetoric and culture, African digital activism, Mediated communication, Theatre and performance, Drama education, First-year writing
